name: FluentCRM
line: Run newsletters and marketing automation on WordPress, with external email delivery.

free.text: Free plugin; you provide WordPress hosting and an email sender

subs.math: 4 campaigns a month to 1,000 contacts. $12 server (DigitalOcean 2GB) plus Amazon SES at $0.16 per 1k emails, with each email 32 KB at $0.12 per GB. Production access assumed; add-ons and tax excluded.
